prompt:
Research the officially documented limits of Cloudflare Workers on the free plan (requests per day, CPU time per request). Cite Cloudflare's own documentation and quote the limits.

Output format (required):
For every claim you attribute to a source, write one line in exactly this form:
SOURCE: <full URL> | QUOTE: "<a sentence copied word-for-word from that page>" | CLAIM: <what you take it to show>
For anything the task asks about that you could not find a source for, write one line:
NO_SOURCE_FOUND: <what you could not find>
You can write normal explanation before or after these lines.

response.content:
Based on Cloudflare's official documentation, here are the key limits for the Workers Free plan:

**Requests per day:** The free plan allows 100,000 requests per day, resetting at midnight UTC.

**CPU time per request:** The free plan allows 10 milliseconds of CPU time per HTTP request invocation.

Here are the specific sources and quotes supporting these claims:

SOURCE: https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers/platform/limits/ | QUOTE: "Accounts on the Workers Free plan have a daily request limit of 100,000 requests, resetting at midnight UTC." | CLAIM: Free plan has 100,000 requests per day limit

SOURCE: https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers/platform/limits/ | QUOTE: "CPU time per HTTP request | Workers Free | Workers Paid | --- | --- | --- | 10 ms | 5 min (default: 30 seconds)" | CLAIM: Free plan has 10ms CPU time limit per HTTP request

SOURCE: https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers/platform/pricing/ | QUOTE: "Free | 100,000 per day | No charge for duration | 10 milliseconds of CPU time per invocation" | CLAIM: Free plan has 100,000 requests per day and 10ms CPU time per invocation

SOURCE: https://www.cloudflare.com/plans/ | QUOTE: "Requests | 100k / day | $0.30 / million requests | CPU Time | 10 ms / request | $0.02 / million CPU ms" | CLAIM: Free plan has 100k requests per day and 10ms CPU time per request
